session_id":"2:dialogue:3","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T11:00:02-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"91ad8c08cf7c4d79b106d3eae1fbe8c8","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"提示铃用响亮那档还是最轻那档？","speaker":"assistant","session_id":"2:dialogue:3","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T11:00:03-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"041ef8e08a5943bfb3509606b7506bea","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"轻的就行，桌面震一下我也看得见。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:3","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T11:00:04-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"e45b5cf5766242819cb2b9fb68ebd943","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"下次下棋我拿黑子，让我后走；这边电梯来了，回头聊。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:3","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T11:00:05-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"4c3ea5560ea74e46b15dbb68f32e8d62","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"替我买礼物不用包装；送客户的那份需要正式封装。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:3","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T11:00:06-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"18e6656db59747b28da8016e16d6cd27","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"今天坐下来聊几件日常的小事。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:00-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"23df4e0803bc479b87790c3fd04e6deb","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"展柜买了六个小底座，正好能两两相伴，没谁孤零零。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:01-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"50ce11d378d149ad86fb70871c8509d9","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"书架最旧的侦探集又被我翻了一遍，没急着拆新书。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:02-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"3d94716f89034222be585379f01ba5a9","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"旧地图满是小标记，我摊开一次就全看到了，空白太多那版反而找半天。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:03-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"a7c0200080a04b7f8659742084a14fdd","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"昨晚听评书，知道谁活下来以后，才留心那些伏笔。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:04-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"815f3e0301824a68b6e80d02069462b4","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"新的签收单写我的全名许闻舟，别用小名。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:05-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"02b3a7ba603c4e4f9a4c772f70283ae9","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"我帮姐姐挑鞋按她的宽脚型，不照我自己的窄版。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:06-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"e5fa4582df8747c3a8640778871a2680","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"夜班那几天我白天睡觉，午后不要敲门。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:07-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"ec2c9aa26ea942f49b2a1061a123fb62","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"棋盒翻出来了，摊开看看吧。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:08-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"492b0fcf4cc74b8d8aff7ddaa7eacbb5","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"盒子摆稳了，咱们慢慢展开。对了，这局你想拿先行的一方还是后行的一方？","speaker":"assistant","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:09-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"64a54bd045644cf8adab69c0126e2738","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"我要后行的黑子。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:4","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T12:00:10-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"53c3cbe5455c4649a12d362d17ca72cd","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"刚忙完一阵，我们随便聊聊吧。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:00-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"6369d971c66e4bf28dd83403f68357f1","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"专辑评论都在夸主打，我倒把冷门曲循环了整晚。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:01-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utterance_id":"0bda9435a9b34691b4ec78bf5aa0d85c","type":"utterance","utterance_text":"阿榕织的围巾掉了一针，那个洞我一直没缝。","speaker":"user","session_id":"2:dialogue:5","occurred_at":"2026-01-05T13:00:02-06:00","event_labels":[]},{"utteran
